description: Search read-only workspace-scoped long-term memory. Results are durable project facts or preferences, not current-file verification. Use recall_context instead for archived tool output and historical messages.

propertyDescriptions.query: A concise query describing the durable project fact or preference to retrieve.
propertyDescriptions.includeInactive: Include superseded and expired audit-history entries. Leave false for ordinary work.

guidance: Use read_memory for long-term project memory only. Search before revise or forget so write_memory receives an ID returned in the same turn. Do not treat a remembered fact as proof of the current checkout; inspect current files or run validation when freshness matters. Use search_context and recall_context for current-thread history.
